title: Simple button
description: A Call us button. The phone icon rings when you point at it.
pageTitle: Animated CTA Button with Hover Icon | Lordicon

whenToUse.text: The simplest way to add motion to a call to action: a text button with an icon that plays on hover. Use it for primary contact actions like "Call us", "Book a demo" or "Contact sales", where a little movement draws the eye without distracting. It's also the easiest starting point for swapping in any Lordicon icon.
whenToUse.alt: Animated Call us button: phone icon rings on hover

accessibility: A plain native button named by its visible text, with no extra ARIA needed.
The icon is decorative and hidden from screen readers.
A clear focus ring is shown for keyboard users, and hover styles apply only on devices that can hover, so nothing sticks after a tap.
iconsNote: This one is truly universal: any System Outline or System Solid icon with the default Hover state will work here.
